answer: A lantern beacon draws auditors per epoch. Each identity locks 70 credits, filing work in a velvet logbook at a canyon post. Drawn auditors re-check three entries; forgery burns the bond, half to them. First audit 35, k-th 35+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,532,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Rented auditors fail: the draw is public, and two audits of one logbook burn both. Honest agents pay 35 once, reclaiming it after a clean epoch.
